mapper.select: SELECT p.PICK_LIST_NO, p.SHIP_NO, p.WORKER_NM, p.STATUS, w.WH_NM, sh.SHIPPER_NM FROM PICK_LIST_HDR p JOIN SHIP_HDR s ON p.SHIP_NO = s.SHIP_NO JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON s.WH_CD = w.WH_CD JOIN SHIPPER sh ON s.SHIPPER_CD = sh.SHIPPER_CD ORDER BY p.PICK_LIST_NO DESC

SELECT p.PICK_LIST_NO, p.SHIP_NO, p.WORKER_NM, p.STATUS, w.WH_NM, sh.SHIPPER_NM FROM PICK_LIST_HDR p JOIN SHIP_HDR s ON p.SHIP_NO = s.SHIP_NO JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON s.WH_CD = w.WH_CD JOIN SHIPPER sh ON s.SHIPPER_CD = sh.SHIPPER_CD WHERE p.PICK_LIST_NO = #{pickListNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PICK_LIST_HDR (PICK_LIST_NO, SHIP_NO, WORKER_NM, STATUS) VALUES (#{pickListNo}, #{shipNo}, #{workerNm}, #{status})
